subject: SIG: Follow-up on access controls (SAML / SCIM / RBAC / MFA) — clarifications needed
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@crescentpay.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: CrescentPay Security <security@crescentpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up — access control details we still need

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the initial SIG answers — our checklist flagged a few follow-ups specifically around access controls before we can move to the next stage in procurement. Could you please provide clarification on the items below?

1) SAML / SSO: we need an assertion flow diagram (IdP → SP) and confirmation of whether you support encrypted assertions and audience restrictions.

2) SCIM provisioning: are there bulk provisioning endpoints and delta syncs? What is your typical provisioning latency SLA, and can you provide a sample provisioning request/response JSON?

3) RBAC / least privilege: we need a role inventory export (CSV) and a short description of how role-to-permission mappings are reviewed/approved.

4) MFA enforcement: is MFA required for all interactive accounts (including admins)? Are there exceptions for service accounts and how are those scoped? Any attestation text or policy excerpt would be helpful.

If possible, attach any small artifacts (diagrams, CSV exports, snippets) rather than large PDFs. We aim to close this by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Clara Nguyen
Security Engineer — CrescentPay
clara.nguyen@crescentpay.com

--
CrescentPay Security Team
security@crescentpay.com

Hi Clara —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached a compact spreadsheet with our SIG access responses and two small artifacts: a SAML assertion diagram and a role inventory export stub. Quick summary below; please find attachments for the explicit examples.

SAML / SSO:
- We support SAML 2.0 with encrypted assertions (AES-256) and audience restriction checks on the SP side.
- We publish metadata (SP) and accept IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.
- See saml-assertion-flow.png for the assertion elements we validate (NameID, authenticator, audience, conditions).

SCIM provisioning:
- We implement SCIM 2.0 endpoints for Users and Groups.
- We support full sync + incremental (delta) via standard SCIM PATCH and bulk endpoints for initial population.
- Typical provisioning latency: initial bulk < 5 minutes for batches up to 5k users; delta processing is near-real-time (under 10s under normal load).
- A sample provisioning JSON and response are in the spreadsheet under the SCIM tab.

RBAC / least privilege:
- Role inventory exported as CSV (role-inventory-20270504.csv). Roles are scoped per-org (customer tenancy) and follow least-privilege templates (Reader, Contributor, ModelAdmin, Billing).
- Role-to-permission mapping is reviewed quarterly by Product Security + Customer Ops; on-boarding changes require a two-person approval (engineer + security).

MFA enforcement:
- Interactive user MFA is required for all human accounts; we enforce via our SSO provider (Okta) with policy-based step-up for admin functions.
- Service accounts are not permitted to use interactive MFA; instead we require short-lived tokens and scoped API keys, rotated automatically.
- See the spreadsheet for the exact policy excerpts.

I've looped in Dev for SCIM endpoint details (small technical clarifications you asked for). If you'd like, we can run a 30-min screen-share to walk through the artifacts and sample requests.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: sig_access_responses_20270504.xlsx, saml-assertion-flow.png

Thanks Tessa — the attachments look helpful. A couple of follow-ups after a quick pass:

- For SCIM: can you confirm whether you support incremental group membership syncs (i.e., group PATCH with members[])? Also, do you accept bulk provisioning via POST /scim/v2/Bulk?
- For role inventory: can you provide one example mapping showing a real permission string (e.g., model:deploy) mapped to a role? We need this to validate downstream entitlement checks.
- For MFA: can you state the date when MFA enforcement for interactive accounts went into effect, and whether historical logs are available for verification (e.g., a small log snippet showing enforcement event)?

If you can drop a SCIM sample payload and a small CSV row for a role mapping, that will close most of this.

-Clara (on behalf of CrescentPay Security)

Hi Clara — quick technical follow-up with the SCIM and RBAC examples you requested.

SCIM notes:
- We support PATCH on /scim/v2/Groups/{id} with members[] updates. We also accept POST /scim/v2/Bulk for initial large imports.
- Example user PATCH (trimmed):
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "Replace", "path": "members", "value": [{"value":"47f8b1","display":"jane.doe@example.com"}]}
  ]
}

- Sample bulk response supports 200/201 per item; we return a job id for asynchronous bulk processing.

RBAC example row (CSV):
org_id,role_id,role_name,permission
org-4321,role-1003,ModelAdmin,model:deploy

MFA enforcement:
- Enforcement date: 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z (policy rollout across production SSO).
- Logs: we can export a small snippet showing enforcement events for a sample user; attaching role-inventory-20270504.csv now (contains the role row above).

Let me know if you need a real sample provisioning call against a sandbox tenant — we can stand one up for CrescentPay.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Platform Engineering — Redwood Inference
